description: This file defines an abstract Android activity class named PickerActivity that provides a searchable list interface. It manages a search box and a list view, retrieves list data asynchronously via an abstract method getList(), filters the list based on search input, and handles item selection with result passing via intents.

classes.name: PickerActivity
classes.description: An abstract activity providing a searchable, selectable list interface. It includes an abstract method getList() for subclasses to supply data, handles filtering/searching, and manages item selection to return results.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to supply the list of items.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout and views, sets up listeners, and starts data loading.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels data loading task and performs cleanup.

methods.name: getSelectedString
methods.description: Retrieves the selected string from an intent extra.

methods.name: getSelectedItem
methods.description: Extracts the item string from the adapter at a given position.

methods.name: onListItemClicked
methods.description: Handles list item click, packages selection into intent, and finishes activity.

methods.name: refreshList
methods.description: Filters the full list based on current search query and updates the displayed list.
